title: Copilot Studio: Review panel shows agent readiness and policy blocks while building
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, Review behaviour, billing statements and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should extend the guidance paths to their settings, cite the managed-environment licensing page and remove the checklist's unmatched managed-environment control check.
